answer:
I found TX-0401 in your account ACC-1005:

- **Amount:** EUR 240.00 (debit)
- **Merchant:** TechMart Online
- **Date:** 2026-07-20
- **Type:** Card payment, status settled

Your records also show a second card payment to TechMart Online for EUR 240.00 on 2026-07-14 (TX-0402). I mention it because it matches the amount, not because I know it is related.

Verta's dispute rules list five reason codes. Each has a window counted from the transaction date. Whether any of them applies depends on what happened, which you haven't told me yet.

| Reason code | Window from transaction date |
|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | 60 days |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 days |
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 days |
| goods_not_received | 90 days |
| service_not_rendered | 90 days |

Based on the reason codes' general purposes:
- **duplicate_charge** may apply if you were charged more than once for the same purchase, such as TX-0401 and TX-0402.
- **unauthorized_debit** may apply if you did not authorise the payment.
- **fraud_card_not_present** may apply if your card details were used without your permission in an online transaction.
- **goods_not_received** may apply if you paid for items that were never delivered.
- **service_not_rendered** may apply if you paid for a service that was not provided.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Reason code guide
## service_not_rendered
Used when a paid-for service was not provided. Evidence: the booking or
contract and the date the service was due.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
